extracted.name: Cheat’s tomato chilli jam
extracted.description: Make our cheat's tomato and chilli jam to serve with burgers – it works beautifully on on our can't believe it's vegan burger. It will keep for two weeks in the fridge
instruction_lines: Put a 400g can chopped tomatoes, 1 finely chopped red chilli, 1 grated thumb-sized piece of ginger, 1 star anise, 250g caster sugar, 150ml red wine vinegar and a pinch of salt in a pan. Bring to a simmer and cook for 30 mins until thick and glossy. Remove from the heat, leave to cool, and transfer to a sterilised jar. Will keep for two weeks, or unopened for up to six months.
